verdicts.reason: Same answer written as a digit.
The Sun is correct, and both answers agree.
London is the city; Wimbledon is a district within it, not a city.
White rum is still rum, so the answers match.
Bad wording: aloe vera has no agave hearts.
verdicts.text: Which plant is used to make tequila: blue agave or aloe vera?
